caption: The drawing displays three objects arranged in a triangular configuration on a plain, light beige background. At the top center, there is a detailed, colored illustration of an oval cameo brooch featuring a profile view of a person's head facing left, with wavy hair adorned with a decorative element. The cameo's figure is depicted in dark purple and black hues, while the background of the brooch is a reddish-brown color, and the outer edge is lighter and glossy. Below the colored cameo are two line drawings in black, both uncolored. The left line drawing shows the reverse side of the brooch, indicating the pin mechanism with a simple oval outline and a horizontal bar with clasp details. The right line drawing depicts the brooch from the side, providing a profile view that reveals the protrusion of the pin mechanism and a cross-sectional view of the figure in low relief. The background has a gradient from darker at the top to lighter at the bottom.
title: Brooch
